open! IStd
module L = Logging

(* Hack: this module does not refer to [HashNormalizer] other than in code generated by inferppx.
   This trips the deadcode script. To appease it, we insert a dead reference to [HashNormalizer]. *)
let _ = HashNormalizer.reset_all_normalizers

type t =
  | HashedBuckOut of string
      (** source file only exists during build under some non-deterministic prefix; however, the
          value here has been post processed to remove non-determinism *)
  | Invalid of {ml_source_file: string}
  | Absolute of string
  | RelativeProjectRoot of string  (** path of the source file relative to the project root *)
  | RelativeProjectRootAndWorkspace of
      { workspace_rel_root: string
            (** path relative to the workspace of the project root with respect to which the source
                file was captured *)

annotation.notes: The initial if-without-else ends as a semicolon sequence element at65. Keep its condition and die call attached. The comment at66–67 attaches to warn_on_error binding and the comment at71 to fname_real; gaps belong before those blocks, not between a comment and its binding. Preserve try/with RHS as one binding. The outer multiline match and its nested matches/parentheses form complete expressions; do not insert gaps within patterns, guards, constructor records or closing parentheses.
